ownership.quote: I'm Claire, co-founder of BrowserAct... Our team comes from a cross-border e-commerce unicorn company

stage.quote: Founded June 1, 2023 🇸🇬 Singapore 201-500 Startup Series C and Beyond
stage.note: AppSumo's auto-generated 'Company details' widget tags BrowserAct as 'Series C and Beyond' with '201-500' employees, but this directly conflicts with the company's own founder posts on the same page describing a small, recently founded (June 2023) indie team selling lifetime deals on AppSumo -- a pattern typical of bootstrapped/small startups, not late-stage-funded ones. No independent source (Crunchbase, Tracxn, press) could be reached to confirm either figure, so this is treated as unreliable/likely mismatched data rather than evidence, and stage is left unknown.

employees.source: AppSumo lists '201-500' employees, but this conflicts with the founder's own account of a small team founded in mid-2023 and could not be corroborated; not treated as reliable.

note: BrowserAct (browseract.com / browseract.ai) is a Singapore-based, no-code AI web-scraping and browser-automation platform, founded June 1, 2023 by co-founder Claire Hu and team, whose backgrounds are described as coming from a 'cross-border e-commerce unicorn company.' It sells via self-serve subscriptions and an AppSumo lifetime-deal listing, which is typical of bootstrapped/small indie SaaS rather than venture-funded startups. No Y Combinator or other accelerator listing was found for BrowserAct (it does not appear in YC's company directory). No funding round, investor, or revenue figure could be confirmed from company sources, GitHub, or AppSumo; Crunchbase, Tracxn, ProductHunt, LinkedIn and G2 company pages all blocked automated access (403/404) and general web search in this environment returned irrelevant results for BrowserAct-specific queries, so funding/revenue/employee count are left unknown rather than guessed.
